description.en-US: The Instructions and Precautions to be observed by one who would be a true religious (the Cautelas and the Counsels to a religious in one piece) and the Censure and Judgment on a nun's prayer, in David Lewis's English with Zimmerman's corrections. Lewis joins what Silverio's Spanish book keeps as separate Cautelas and Consejos, so this is its own book.
description.pt-BR: As Instruções e precauções e a Censura de São João da Cruz na versão inglesa de David Lewis (revista por Zimmerman, 1919).

sources.edition: The Living Flame of Love, with his Letters, Poems and Minor Writings, translated by David Lewis, with corrections and an introduction by Benedict Zimmerman, O.C.D., London: Thomas Baker, 1919 (first edition 1912). Internet Archive scan johnofthecross00johnuoft (University of Toronto).
sources.description: Instructions and Precautions; Censure and Judgment of the Blessed Father. The scan is the best of the three; page headings, page numbers and footnotes are dropped, line-break hyphens joined, and isolated recognition slips may remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1919, before 1930; public domain in the US.

title.en-US: Censure and Judgment on the Spirit and Method of Prayer of a Nun
